subject: Carrier vetting for the summer auto parts lanes
body_preview: Floyd, we are ramping the Knoxville to Indianapolis runs again this summer. Can you make sure the carriers are vetted and insured before we commit any loads?

subject: Re: Carrier vetting for the summer auto parts lanes
body_preview: Glen, will do. We are running our refresh on every carrier touching automotive freight this quarter. I will have authority, insurance, and safety scores pulled before anything moves.

subject: Re: Carrier vetting for the summer auto parts lanes
body_preview: Appreciate it. First pickup would be the week of the 15th. Ridgeline handled us well last year if they have capacity.

subject: Re: Carrier vetting for the summer auto parts lanes
body_preview: Already talking to Earl over at Ridgeline. I will lock in two trucks for that week and send you the rate confirmation by Friday.

subject: Summer grain haul schedule
body_preview: Floyd, our co-op will have steady outbound loads from Nashville starting late June. Wanted to get on your calendar before the season gets busy.

subject: Re: Summer grain haul schedule
body_preview: Good to hear from you Ruth. Let us hop on a call Friday the 12th and map out the volume. I can usually cover Nashville outbound with no trouble.

subject: Re: Summer grain haul schedule
body_preview: Friday works. 1:30 your time. I will have the tonnage estimates ready to share.

subject: TN Freight Association annual conference
body_preview: Floyd, registration is open for the October conference at the Volunteer Conference Center. As a past panelist we would love to have you back on the broker roundtable.

subject: Re: TN Freight Association annual conference
body_preview: Glad to do it Gail. Sign me up for the roundtable. Keith Burgess and I are also kicking off the mentorship program this fall, so I may say a few words on that if there is time.

subject: Re: TN Freight Association annual conference
body_preview: Wonderful. I will pencil in a mentorship segment. Your badge and agenda will go out in September.

subject: Contract renewal for the Gap lanes
body_preview: Floyd, our hauling agreement comes up at the end of the month. Fuel has settled some so I can hold last year's rates if we sign for another twelve.

subject: Re: Contract renewal for the Gap lanes
body_preview: Cecil, that is fair and I appreciate you holding the line. You have always run clean for us out of Harlan. Let me have Bren update the paperwork and I will get it back to you this week.

subject: Re: Contract renewal for the Gap lanes
body_preview: Sounds good. Tell your mama June we said hello next time you are up the mountain.

subject: Re: Contract renewal for the Gap lanes
body_preview: Will do. Signed copy is attached. Good doing business with you another year.

subject: Building supply rates for Q3
body_preview: Floyd, lumber and drywall volume is picking up. Can you take a look at our outbound rates? A couple lanes feel high compared to last quarter.

subject: Re: Building supply rates for Q3
body_preview: Pete, fair point. Some of that is fuel surcharge that should have rolled off. Let me pull the lane history and we can talk Tuesday at 10. I think I can shave a few of those down.

subject: Re: Building supply rates for Q3
body_preview: Tuesday at 10 is good. Thanks for looking into it, Floyd. You always shoot straight with us.

subject: Mentorship program - fall cohort
body_preview: Floyd, I think we can take six mentees this round. I have two young dispatchers from my side who would be a good fit. How many can WFS bring?

subject: Re: Mentorship program - fall cohort
body_preview: Six is a good number to start. I will put Brand in to help run it and bring two from our dispatch side. Let us nail down a curriculum over poker Thursday.

subject: Re: Mentorship program - fall cohort
body_preview: Works for me. I will bring the outline I sketched out. Bring your appetite, I am smoking a pork shoulder for it.

subject: Q2 numbers before our review
body_preview: Floyd, attached is the draft P&L through May. Revenue is tracking right where we expected. We will go over owner distributions when we meet on the 15th.

subject: Re: Q2 numbers before our review
body_preview: Thanks Wayne. Looks about right to me. I want to talk through setting aside a little more for the software upgrade when we sit down.
